# The Landscaping Yard

## About
The Landscaping Yard and Hardware has been servicing customers in Kallangur and all areas from the Sunshine Coast to the Gold Coast since December 1994. Brett and his friendly team have developed a reputation for being there when you need them by opening 7 days and delivering to all areas. Based at 151 Dohles Rocks Road, Kallangur, QLD.

## Services
Turf Supplies
Gravel & Stones
Pavers
Retaining Walls

## Service Areas
Kallangur
Sunshine Coast to Gold Coast (all areas)
